solves.reasoning: skin and bones, clothes worn → homeless, worn; feeling pity → pity
terribly in need of something to eat; paying attention to the dog; brought tears to Jennifer's eyes
selfless giving and love; mothers struggling to raise children; made Jennifer a better person
prosperous(부유한)는 skin and bones/worn clothes와 모순 → homeless가 원문
barely in need(거의 필요 없음)는 felt so bad for her와 모순 → terribly가 원문
refusing to raise children(키우기 거부)는 도움 대상으로 부적절 → struggling이 원문
gas station은 고정 표현, gas + restaurant/hospital/parking lot은 부자연스러움
by her appearance = 외모로 판단. 다음 문장에 옷과 체형 묘사가 근거
She looked so happy to do it = 개에게 먹이를 주고 행복해 보였다
noticed = observed (인지하다, 알아채다). ignored/avoided/forgot은 반대 의미
entirely = completely (완전히). partially는 반의어
struggling = striving (힘겹게 노력하다). succeeding/relaxing/celebrating은 반대 상황
selfless(이타적) ↔ greedy(탐욕적). generous/humble은 유사, brave는 다른 축
worn(낡은) ↔ brand-new(새것). torn/faded/stained은 worn과 유사
could tell = 알아채다/파악하다. 두 문맥 모두 인지/판단의 의미
sympathy and sadness for someone suffering = pity(동정, 연민)의 정의
분사구문: Jennifer thought, feeling pity → 동시동작 현재분사
were + V-ing = 과거진행형 → walking
went into the store, [bought a can of dog food], and fed that dog
It took a homeless woman to show her what selfless giving and love is
